# Ave

> Ave is a free Catholic prayer app built for Uganda. It offers the Holy Rosary, novenas, chaplets, the Stations of the Cross and daily morning, midday and night prayers in English, Luganda (Oluganda) and Runyankore (Orunyankore). It runs in any web browser, can be installed on Android and iPhone from the browser, and works offline. No account is needed to pray.

Key facts:
- Website: https://ave-prayers.vercel.app
- Price: free, no ads
- Languages: English, Luganda, Runyankore
- Optional free account: saves favourite prayers and tracks prayer progress (day streaks, novena days) across devices
- Contact: stelarlabs@gmail.com

## Prayers

- [The Holy Rosary](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/rosary): the Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious and Luminous Mysteries
- [Full guided Rosary](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/prayer/session): step by step from the Apostles' Creed, through five decades with the Fatima Prayer, to the Hail Holy Queen
- [Morning prayers](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/daily-prayer/morning)
- [Midday prayers](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/daily-prayer/midday)
- [Night prayers](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/daily-prayer/night)
- [Novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Help](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/2): 18 to 26 June, with the Litany of Our Lady of Perpetual Help
- [Novena to St. Jude](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/6): nine days, patron of difficult cases
- [Novena to the 13 Blessed Souls](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/7): thirteen days
- [Novena to Pope St. Leo the Great](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/8): nine days, 1 to 9 November
- [Novena to Our Lady of Guadalupe](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/9): 3 to 11 December
- [Novena to the Holy Name of Jesus](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/10): 25 December to 2 January
- [Novena to Our Lady of Hope](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/11): 8 to 16 January
- [30 Day Novena to St. Joseph](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/12): 30 days before 19 March
- [Novena for Fertility to Conceive a Baby](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/13)
- [Divine Mercy Novena](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/5): Good Friday to the Saturday after Easter
- [Novena to Our Lady of Fatima](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/14): 4 to 12 May
- [Novena to St. Dominic](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/15): 30 July to 7 August
- [Novena to Our Lady of Sorrows](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/novena/16): 6 to 14 September
- [Chaplet of the Divine Mercy](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/chaplet/1)
- [Stations of the Cross](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/stations)
- [Our Lady of Guadalupe](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/other-prayer/guadalupe)
- [Our Lady of Fatima](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/other-prayer/fatima)
- [Magnificat](https://ave-prayers.vercel.app/other-prayer/magnificat)
